# Traefik — load-balancer-sse

Two backends with sticky sessions, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Affinity has to hold both for the EventSource GET and for the separate client-to-server POSTs.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Two backends, sticky sessions, PUSH over Server-Sent Events through a proxy
# that cannot upgrade a connection.
#
# Affinity has to hold for two different things here: the EventSource GET that
# streams the push channel, and the separate client-to-server XHR POSTs to the
# same path. Both carry the ROUTEID cookie Traefik set, so both land on the
# backend that owns the session.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - no-websocket
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        sticky:
          cookie:
            name: ROUTEID
            path: /
            httpOnly: true
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin-1:8080
          - url: http://vaadin-2:8080

  middlewares:
    no-websocket:
      headers:
        customRequestHeaders:
          Upgrade: ""
          Connection: ""

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
